events.verdict: Avdija (POR) pins the ball to his side and resumes his dribble thereafter.
Green (GSW) turns into Avdija (POR) and delivers body contact as he defends the shot.
Camara (POR) and Butler III (GSW) come together at the end of the drive and the contact is marginal.
Avdija (POR) legally contests Melton's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Cissoko (POR) and Green (GSW) come together as they pursue the rebound, and the contact is marginal.

Green (GSW) cleanly deflects the ball away from Cissoko (POR).  Any ensuing contact to Cissoko's head/face that occurs after the deflection is considered incidental.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Cissoko (POR) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Melton (GSW) is not in a legal guarding position when lower body contact occurs with Grant (POR) during his shot attempt.
Green (GSW) firms up over his right leg in Sharpe's (POR) path prior to the contact.
Camara (POR) and Butler III (GSW) come together on the perimeter, and incidental leg to leg contact occurs following the expiration of the pick.
Curry's (GSW) left foot does not step on the sideline while he is in possession of the ball.
Cissoko (POR) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Curry (GSW) dislodges the ball from Sharpe (POR).
Grant (POR) legally contests Curry's (GSW) shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) avoids making any illegal contact with Butler III (GSW) during his tip-in attempt at the basket.
Avdija (POR) legally contests Butler III's (GSW) tip-in attempt at the basket.
Green (GSW) initiates contact with Avdija's (POR) arms that affects his control of the ball.
Green (GSW) leans forward towards Sharpe (POR) as he firms up in his path.
Camara (POR) deflects the ball away from Curry (GSW).
Green (GSW)) commits a take foul on Sharpe (POR). After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined the foul did not meet the criteria for a clear path foul
Replay review of the foul called on Melton (GSW) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Melton wraps Grant (POR) and affects his ability to receive the inbound pass.
Avdija (POR) initiates body contact with Butler III (GSW) prior to making any contact with the ball.
Green (GSW) turns into Grant's (POR) path and delivers contact that dislodges Grant during the screen.
Sharpe (POR) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
